scope: Independent static review of paired arithmetic and producer/schema compatibility. No analysis functions executed.
verified: Actual producer rows use rotation, kind, metrics, profile.selected.phases, elapsed_ns, checks, kestrel_checks, authored_input_unchanged and wal_empty exactly as read by analysis.

The driver emits six rotations, each a permutation of control/baseline/candidate. Analysis requires eighteen total rows and all three kinds in every rotation1..6; those combined cardinalities exclude missing, duplicate or outside-rotation rows.
Only same-rotation baseline/candidate values are subtracted. Control is checked for group presence and is not pooled with diagnostic lanes. No earlier batch is read.

Legacy insertion is the same-trial sum of exclusive leaf_insert_known and leaf_input_durations. Pure leaf is semantic_leaf_apply residual plus leaf_insert_known, leaf_input_durations and leaf_net_construction; these are disjoint exclusive rows, not inclusive parent durations.

Thirty-five unique phase names and exact outer conservation are checked. The upstream strict parser also enforces exact ordered names/counts, integer bounds, zero checkpoint and single block; measure requires finite nonnegative metrics, exact checks and immutable inputs.

Differences and relative reductions are computed per pair before min/median/max aggregation. The method labels independent fresh invocations and diagnostic status and makes no percentile, target, calibrated overhead or significance claim.

Completed measurement terminal is required and output uses exclusive creation. A zero baseline denominator fails rather than silently manufacturing a relative result; actual values remain unknown before measurement.
limitations: Measurement has not been reviewed or executed here. No measured gain or validation pass is claimed.
The analysis trusts the completed guarded producer records; later packaging must continue to bind raw reports, trials, source/binary identities and terminal receipts.
